tiers.name: Starter
tiers.summary: Erasable Crayola colors, 12 Onyx rollerballs, 12 HB pencils, tub sharpener and 3 Mono erasers.

items.name: Crayola Erasable Colored Pencils, 24 ct
items.why: Cheapest way to get 24 colors, and they erase.

items.name: uni-ball Onyx Rollerball Pens, Micro Point 0.5mm, Black (12 ct)
items.why: Fast-drying archival rollerball ink; 12 pens covers an 8-player group with spares.

items.name: Ticonderoga Wood-Cased Pencils, #2 HB, 12 ct
items.why: Erasable first-draft pencil, unsharpened so each pencil starts with its full length.

items.name: STAEDTLER Double-Hole Tub Pencil Sharpener
items.why: Tub catches the shavings; the second hole takes the thicker colored pencils.

items.name: Tombow MONO Eraser, White, Medium (3-pack)
items.why: Cleans graphite and erasable colored pencil without smearing; three keeps one per player cluster.

fit.colors_drawer: 24 Crayola pencils (~178 mm, ~7.4 mm hex) lie lengthwise with ~34 mm to spare. Two layers of 12 use about 14 mm of the 50.3 mm height and ~90 mm of the 142.65 mm width. Drawer capacity at this diameter is roughly 19 per layer by 7 layers (~130).
fit.lines_drawer: 12 Onyx (~145 mm, ~11 mm dia) in 2 rows of 6 plus 12 Ticonderoga (~190 mm) in one layer fit in two layers (~30 mm high). Sharpener (~50 mm) and erasers sit in the ~65 mm free at the pen ends. Fits without crowding.

tiers.name: Good
tiers.summary: Prismacolor Premier 24, Ben's two favorites (Zig Mangaka Flexible and Onyx), graphite set, sharpener and eraser.
tiers.upgrade_note: Over Starter: soft-core Prismacolor Premier colors (richer, blend better, but break more if dropped), Ben's favorite Mangaka Flexible brush-feel pen, and a graded graphite set.

items.name: Prismacolor Premier Colored Pencils, Soft Core, 24 ct
items.why: Rich, saturated color from a soft wax core; the popular step up from school pencils.

items.name: Kuretake ZIG Cartoonist Mangaka Flexible, Fine, Black (CNMF-010)
items.why: Ben's favorite: flexible tip gives thick-thin lines on a water-based pigment ink that dries quickly.

items.name: uni-ball Onyx Rollerball Pens, Micro Point 0.5mm, Black (12 ct)
items.why: Ben's other favorite; dependable fast-drying fine line, plenty for the whole table.

items.name: Faber-Castell Graphite Sketch Pencil Set, 6 pencils (2H, HB, B, 2B, 4B, 6B)
items.why: Graded set; players can pick a dark soft pencil for sketching.

items.name: STAEDTLER Double-Hole Tub Pencil Sharpener
items.why: Tub catches the shavings; the second hole takes the thicker colored pencils.

items.name: Tombow MONO Eraser, White, Medium (3-pack)
items.why: Cleans graphite and erasable colored pencil without smearing; three keeps one per player cluster.

fit.colors_drawer: 24 Prismacolor (~178 mm, ~7.5 mm) lie lengthwise with ~34 mm to spare, 12 per layer in two layers (~14 mm high). Roughly 19 per layer by 7 layers (~130) fits, so there is room to add a second set later.
fit.lines_drawer: 12 Onyx and 2 Zig (~150 mm) fit in one pen layer (~11-12 mm), 6 graphite (~175 mm) in a layer beside them; stack height ~25 mm of 50.3. Sharpener and erasers go in the ~60 mm free at the pen ends.

tiers.name: Deluxe
tiers.summary: Polychromos 36 tin, Zig and Onyx plus Pigma Micron 01, graphite set, KUM sharpener and two eraser types.
tiers.upgrade_note: Over Good: Faber-Castell Polychromos (oil-based, hard core, holds a point and rarely smears, 36 colors), a Pigma Micron 01 six-pack for fine detail, a metal KUM sharpener, and a second eraser type (Staedtler Mars plastic).

items.name: Faber-Castell Polychromos Artists' Color Pencils, Tin of 36
items.why: Artist-grade oil-based leads hold a point and don't smear when sheets are folded.

SAKURA Pigma Micron Fineliner Pens, Black, 01 (0.25 mm), 6 Pack
items.why: Archival pigment fineliner with a very fine line for detail drawing.

items.name: Faber-Castell Graphite Sketch Pencil Set, 6 pencils (2H, HB, B, 2B, 4B, 6B)
items.why: Graded set; players can pick a dark soft pencil for sketching.

items.name: KUM 103.28.31 Magnesium Alloy 2-Hole Barrel Pencil Sharpener with Waste Container
items.why: Metal body, sharp steel blades and a screw-on waste container for shavings; colors vary.

items.name: Tombow MONO Eraser, White, Medium (3-pack)
items.why: Cleans graphite and erasable colored pencil without smearing; three keeps one per player cluster.

items.name: STAEDTLER Mars Plastic Vinyl Erasers (4-Pack)
items.why: Leaves the least residue on printer paper; good for cleaning up pencil lines.

fit.colors_drawer: Tin dimensions not verified, so the plan is to loose-pack the pencils: 36 x ~175 mm (~7.5 mm) lie lengthwise with ~37 mm to spare, 3 layers of 12 about 20 mm high, ~30 mm headroom.
fit.lines_drawer: 12 Onyx, 2 Zig, 6 Micron, 6 graphite (~175 mm) in two layers (~25 mm high of 50.3). KUM sharpener and the two eraser packs fit in the ~60 mm free at the pen ends. Lines drawer is about half full.
